chunk_view_3.name: chunk_view_3
chunk_view_3.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(s_counts.student_count, 0) AS student_count,
  COALESCE(s_counts.max_full_name_length, 0) AS max_full_name_length
FROM sis_department d
LEFT JOIN sis_admin_department ad
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    COUNT(*) AS student_count,
    MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(
      TRIM(
        CONCAT(
          COALESCE(ps.FIRST_NAME, ''),
          CASE WHEN ps.MIDDLE_NAME IS NULL OR ps.MIDDLE_NAME = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', ps.MIDDLE_NAME) END,
          CASE WHEN (ps.FIRST_NAME IS NULL OR ps.FIRST_NAME = '') AND (ps.MIDDLE_NAME IS NULL OR ps.MIDDLE_NAME = '') THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', COALESCE(ps.LAST_NAME, '')) END
        )
      )
    )) AS max_full_name_length
  FROM student_degree_program sd
  JOIN se_person ps
    ON sd.DEGREE_CODE = sd.DEGREE_CODE -- kept as placeholder join key in this chunk (actual student-to-department link is in another chunk)
  GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT
) s_counts
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s_counts.department_code

chunk_view_4.name: chunk_view_4
chunk_view_4.body_sql:
SELECT
  unit.UNIT_NAME AS department_name,
  unit.OFFICE_PHONE AS department_phone,
  COALESCE(COUNT(st.MIT_ID), 0) AS student_count,
  COALESCE(MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(st.FIRST_NAME, ''),
      CASE WHEN st.MIDDLE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND st.MIDDLE_NAME <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', st.MIDDLE_NAME) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN (st.MIDDLE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND st.MIDDLE_NAME <> '') OR (st.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL AND st.LAST_NAME <> '') THEN CONCAT(' ', COALESCE(st.LAST_NAME, '')) WHEN st.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(st.LAST_NAME, '') ELSE '' END
    )
  )), 0) AS max_full_name_length
FROM warehouse_users st
RIGHT JOIN (
  -- departments inferred from warehouse_users UNIT_NAME/UNIT_ID presence in this chunk
  SELECT DISTINCT UNIT_NAME, UNIT_ID, OFFICE_PHONE
  FROM warehouse_users
) unit ON st.UNIT_NAME = unit.UNIT_NAME
GROUP BY unit.UNIT_NAME, unit.OFFICE_PHONE, unit.UNIT_ID
